Safety Precautions

A 
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of the
fan motor

Disconnect electric terminals of
fan motor

The fan must be isolated mechanically
by closing delivery damper

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check static parts for deteriorated paint
and for scaling

Inspect impeller for deposits and wear 
and wash if there are deposits and change the blades or make balance in case of 
wear

Check damper and vane control assemblies
for grease and protect unpainted surfaces with rust ban or sprayed fuel oil

Check blader
for freedom of movement

Check fan flexible connections and joint
for damage
Check coupling clearance 6-10mm

Check inboard and outboard bearing
clearance and change the bearing if required
Check shaft alignment

Re-grease 
and change oil

annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

combustion air to meet the boiler demand under varying conditions quickly and efficiently.
